alt: The same whitetail buck relief carved at three sizes, large, medium and small, standing side by side on a workbench
Two copies of the same relief seen edge-on: one carved at full depth with clear layers, one flattened so the layers collapse
Macro of a carved eye with a tiny tapered ball nose cutter held beside it for scale
A carved panel sawn in half to show its cross-section: the carved profile on top and the solid floor of wood left beneath the deepest cut
A small test tile of the buck's head carved on an offcut, held up against the full panel
